[b]Latest News[/b]

[b][i]Sikirsk gains full THEP membership[/i][/b]

Today during a THEP meeting, the alliance voted to grant the grand federation of [nation]Sikirsk[/nation] full membership after over 20 years of observer membership. The vote comes after peace was successfully secured in the Hydronian front of the THEP-EDU war, bringing stability back to the continent and ending sikirsks armed involvement in the war for now.

[b][i]Hydronian National Elections[/i][/b]

Its December and that means that its Hydronian election season! The five main parties will once again be put against each other for political supremacy. Many experts say that the social unity partys time in power is finally over after unrest over the THEP-EDU conflict. Here is a brief overview of the parties and their goals this season.

[list]
[b]Social Unity Party - IN POWER[/b]
Leader: Kaplan Zorlu
Ideologies: Democratic Socialism, Liberalism
Position: Left / Center-left

This election, the social democrats have told the people they will continue to enact social and economic reforms to bring the wealth gap down along with creating a fair trade deal with the Neue Republik to wrap up the shar accords.

[b]Hydronian Conservative Party[/b]
Leader: Murat Seliban
Ideologies: Conservatism, Economic liberalism
Position: Right / Center-right

This election, the conservatives have promised to fix the post-war economy and work hard to rebuild infrastructure. They have also emphasised the importance of neutral relations with the EDU to end the ongoing rivalry.

[b]Green Future for Hydronia Movement[/b]
Leader: Ela Kimyacioglu
Ideologies: Environmentalism
Position: Left

This election, the greens have made pledges to address environmental concerns in the mining and oil industry, especially in the states of Lumir and Turqevia. They have also emphasised that if a deal is struck with the Neue Republik, it must address environmental damage caused by the war.

[b]Hydronian Preservationists party[/b]
Leader: Durul Agca
Ideologies: Nationalism, Far-right populism
Position: Far-Right

This election, the preservationists have made it clear that they wish to expel the Neue Republik from Hydronian affairs. They have also stated that they will tone down Hydronias interventionism and will crack down on borders. They are starkly opposed to the ongoing talks within THEP to create a centralised passport system.

[b]Liberal Party of Hydronia[/b]
Leader: Sidika Buruk
Ideologies: Centrism, Liberalism
Position: Center

This election, the liberalism have also promised to reduce Hydronias interventionism. They have also said they will liberalise the countrys economy along with a fair trade deal with the Neue Republik.
[/list]
